label: aibl 表型/刺激提取
description: Extract and merge AIBL phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads AIBL phenotype files (cognitive assessments, blood biomarkers, APOE genotype, demographics), selects columns, aligns visits, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing AIBL phenotype CSV/TSV files (directory); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.
